remarks: Location! Location! A well-maintained East Norwalk two units multifamily located at a prime area near Westport. A short walk to the East Norwalk Metro North Train Station for easy access to New York City and Stamford. Each unit has two generous size bedrooms, living room, eat-in kitchen and a full bath. Laundry hook-up for each unit in a partitioned basement. Each unit has a large deck overlooking the back yard. Private driveway with plenty of off-street parking. A fantastic investment opportunity. Won't last long!
